message.content: Two volunteers edited the same tide-pool survey while offline and one of them lost their species counts after syncing. Can you look at how sync merges records?

content.text: Offline edit conflicts now use field-level last-writer-wins: each field keeps its own updated_at timestamp and the sync worker merges field by field. The old whole-record overwrite was wiping species counts whenever the other volunteer had only touched the weather notes.
